principles: Fix only the real PLAN blocker guidance issue.
Preserve reviewer-written scope evidence and existing gate semantics.
Keep local CLI Non-authority evidence separate from Authority Server receipt-backed completion.
drivers: Operators misread missing_scope_check as a missing command or document-content issue.
story_review currently has the canonical blocker text and scope_check_save help omits the PLAN evidence relationship.
Authority mode is not configured locally, so any Authority completion claim must fail closed.

options.name: A: Narrow story_review message plus scope_check_save help and targeted smoke
pros: Updates the exact surfaces where the operator sees the blocker and the command shape.
Adds regression coverage for the wording and negative Authority/self-signing constraints.
cons: Does not create a broad session assistant; only fixes this blocker path.

options.name: B: Add a new recovery assistant command
cons: Broader than the observed correctness issue.
Risks arbitrary optimization and new command surface without need.

options.name: C: Auto-create scope-check.json when missing
pros: Would make PLAN blocker disappear quickly.
cons: Weakens PLAN gate and enables self-signing, so it is not acceptable.

chosen: A: Narrow story_review message plus scope_check_save help and targeted smoke
rationale: Choose the narrow canonical text/help/test change because it fixes the real actionability failure without weakening PLAN gates or inventing Authority proof.

preMortem.scenario: Message implies the main agent may create scope-check.json manually
preMortem.trigger: Wording says create or save scope-check without naming reviewer-written scope-plan evidence
preMortem.consequence: PLAN gate can be socially bypassed even if code does not auto-generate evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Wording must say scope-plan reviewer writes evidence via scope_check_save and tests assert no self-signing language.

preMortem.scenario: Local CLI guidance is mistaken for Authority completion
preMortem.trigger: Text mentions Authority without receipt requirements
preMortem.consequence: User may believe local review pass equals production or Authority DONE
preMortem.mitigation: Wording and tests must keep receiptVerified/authorityDone/productionDone/fullAuthorityDone out of local guidance except as non-claims.

preMortem.scenario: scope_contract_check is suggested as the fix
preMortem.trigger: Implementation reuses later-phase scope contract language for PLAN blocker
preMortem.consequence: Operator runs wrong command and still lacks scope-check.json
preMortem.mitigation: Message must identify scope-check.json and scope_check_save, and avoid scope_contract_check as missing_scope_check remediation.
